clusters.mechanism: Orphan fallback in processes-darwin.ts treats any hidden-environment process born during the invocation with a cwd under the worktree as an invocation member without proof of ancestry or marker ownership, so cleanup signals unrelated processes.
The gate-timeout rerun's second checkoutCommitted call omits retryClean, so a failing clean throws CommandError instead of WorktreeCleanError and bypasses the recovery handler.
Process-group/session membership is only accepted for hidden-environment processes, so a same-group descendant with a visible explicit environment lacking markers is missed and left running.
